Declare a function in the pipeline config

## Usage

`circleci function add <name> [flags]`

## Flags

| Flag                  | Description                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--as string`         | alias a step invokes it by (default: the function's name)                         |
| `-c, --config string` | Path to the pipeline config file (default ".circleci/config.yml")                 |
| `-n, --dry-run`       | show the change without writing it                                                |
| `--jq string`         | Process values from the response using jq syntax (see `circleci help formatting`) |
| `--json`              | Output as JSON                                                                    |
| `--version string`    | version to pin (default: the latest release)                                      |

Global flags: `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Examples

- Declare a function at its latest version: 
  `circleci function add setup-go`
- Declare a specific version under a chosen alias: 
  `circleci function add setup-go --version v0.6.0 --as go`
- Preview the change without writing it: 
  `circleci function add setup-go --dry-run`

## Details

Resolve a function's latest version and declare it in the
`functions` block of the pipeline config.

A default alias that clashes with an orb or command gets `-fn` appended.

JSON fields: alias, function, version, config, step.
